LanguageData.Make_Raven_DarkfeatherSteel.description: A temporary fallback recipe that can be completed at a vanilla smithy without magma. Its material efficiency is very low, yielding only about one quarter as much darkfeather steel from the same solid ingredients as the automated foundry.
